new_jobs.description:
Alternatively, Grant Thornton

At Grant Thornton we do things differently - looking to the future, driving ambitious growth and pioneering positive change in our industry. Providing audit, tax and advisory services, we empower clients through strategic insight, curiosity, and genuine partnership. And we empower our people with real opportunity, an inclusive culture and work life balance. A true alternative.

With over 5,000 people in the UK, and a presence in 150 global markets, we're on an ambitious journey, from great to exceptional, and we need the best people to help us achieve our potential. And with that comes the opportunity to help redefine what our industry looks like, and what you want from your career.

Job Description:

MORE THAN YOU EXPECTED

Grant Thornton UK LLP is part of a global network of independent audit, tax and advisory firms, made up of some 58,000 people in over 135 countries. We're a team of independent thinkers who put quality, inclusion and integrity first. All around the world we bring a different experience to our clients. A better experience. One that delivers the expertise they need in a way that goes beyond. Personal, proactive, and agile. That's Grant Thornton.

NEW GROUND WON’T BREAK ITSELF.

Every day our teams help people in businesses and communities to do what is right and achieve their goals.

We're hiring Senior Engineers into our team, based in the North of England. You'll be a hands-on individual contributor, enabling our client facing teams, building real solutions that create measurable value, concentrating your engineering effort on solving in our GenAI platform, or building around and outside it when needed.

We’re happy to talk flexible working and consider reduced hours and job shares, we’ll support you to balance your work and life.

A look into the role

As a Senior Engineer within our team:

You'll work within a forward deployed engineering team or a delivery pod aligned to one of our service lines, alongside a product manager and under the technical direction of a Lead Engineer. The work spans the full stack of what engineering needs to do around a GenAI platform: solving problems natively, backend plumbing, API integrations, MCP server builds, and data connections.

Working in our GenAI platform doesn't always mean writing code. Often it means applying engineering judgement to solve problems natively, designing the right architecture, the right integration, the right data flow, directly within the platform itself. Knowing which mode the problem calls for is part of the craft here.

At Senior Engineer level, you'll own your delivery end-to-end. You translate business need into solutions and technical design, and work individually or as part of the team to solve those in the best way at pace.

You're fluent across AI-native engineering from building natively in the platform, using AI tooling to accelerate your own craft, and taking coalface experiments through to production-grade operationalised solutions.

At Senior Engineer level, that fluency is already there and you apply it independently.

Knowing you’re right for us

Joining us as a Senior Engineer, the minimum criteria you’ll need is

At Senior Engineer level you have a track record of owning delivery end-to-end in a team-based model. You've shipped production software and can speak to the decisions you made. You have real depth in backend and integration engineering using Python or C# .Net, and genuine judgement about when to solve natively in the platform and when bespoke engineering is the right call.

It would be great if you had some of the following skills, but don’t worry if you don’t tick every box, we’ll help you develop along the way.

Across both levels familiarity with Azure and Microsoft 365 is an advantage. Hands-on experience with LLM integration patterns, MCP tooling, and AI-enabled or agentic development environments is genuinely valued.
AI and LLM experience - you're comfortable using GenAI tools such as Copilot, Claude or ChatGPT.

Knowing we’re right for you

Embracing uniqueness, the culture at Grant Thornton thrives on the contributions of all our people, we never settle for what is easy, we look beyond to deliver the right thing, for everyone. Building an inclusive culture, where we value difference and respect our colleagues helps our people to perform at the best of their ability and realise their potential.

Our open and accessible culture means you’ll interact with leaders who are interested in you and everything you bring to our firm. The things that set you apart, we value them. That’s why we give you the freedom to bring your whole self to work and pursue your passions inside and outside of work.

Beyond the job

Life is more than work. The things you do, and the people you’re with outside of work matter, that’s why we’re happy to look at flexible working options for all our roles, and we’ll always do our best to keep your work and life in balance.

The impact you can make here will go far beyond your day job. From secondments, to fundraising for local charities, or investing in entrepreneurs in the developing world, you’ll be giving back to society . It’s that drive to do the right thing that runs through our every move, grounded in our firm’s values – purposefully driven, actively curious and candid but kind.

We’re looking for people who want to contribute, spark fresh ideas and go beyond expectations. People who want to be able to proudly do what’s right, for the firm, our clients, our people and themselves. It’s how it should be.

new_jobs.description:
Delivery Manager - Systems Integration

Location: London / Hybrid
Salary: £53,000 - £61,000
Contract: 12-month Fixed Term Contract

The Opportunity
. We are looking for an experienced Delivery Manager to take ownership of multiple systems integration workstreams within a complex technology environment.
This is a hands-on delivery role requiring genuine experience of managing systems integrations through middleware/integration platforms. You don’t need experience of a particular technology stack or sector, but you must have personally owned the delivery of integration projects rather than simply supported them through PMO or governance.
Experience of legacy integrations, cloud environments and migrating integrations from one middleware platform to another would be particularly valuable.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own and drive multiple systems integration workstreams from planning through to go-live and BAU.
Manage integration delivery across middleware platforms, APIs, cloud and legacy systems.
Coordinate developers, engineers, architects, business stakeholders and third-party suppliers.
Manage delivery through the SDLC, including requirements, design, development, testing, deployment and operational handover.
Identify and actively manage technical risks, issues and dependencies.
Anticipate potential delivery problems and ensure appropriate mitigation is in place.
Escalate significant risks and issues at the right time, with clear impact and recommended actions.
Maintain delivery plans, priorities, resources and dependencies across concurrent workstreams.
Ensure lessons and root causes from previous integrations inform future delivery.

What We’re Looking For. At least 5 years’ hands-on project/delivery management experience specifically within systems integration.

Demonstrable experience personally owning and delivering integration projects.
Experience working with middleware or integration platforms within cloud-based environments.
Good practical understanding of APIs, middleware, integration patterns and technical dependencies.
Experience managing integration delivery through the full SDLC.
Legacy integration and/or middleware migration experience would be highly desirable.
Strong risk, issue and dependency management skills.
Ability to understand technical delivery risks without needing to be a developer.
Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple integration workstreams.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management across technical teams, the business, senior stakeholders and suppliers.
Good judgement - able to take ownership of problems while recognising when an issue needs escalating.

About you.
You are someone who understands what is really happening across their projects - not simply whether milestones are red or green. You’ll know where the key risks and dependencies sit, what problems may be coming, what is being done to mitigate them and when stakeholders need to be involved. If you have personally owned the delivery of complex systems integrations and are comfortable getting into the technical detail required to drive successful delivery, we’d like to hear from you.

Send your CV to Simon at sdunscombe@itecopeople.co.uk

From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.

We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation.

We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do.

Job Description

Senior Integration Engineer

We are seeking an experienced API Engineer to design, build, secure, and operate enterprise-grade APIs that integrate cloud platforms with on‑premise banking application suites. The role focuses on developing reliable and scalable integration services, enabling secure data exchange across channels and systems (core banking, payments, fraud, risk, CRM, digital platforms), while meeting stringent regulatory, availability, and security requirements.

You will work closely with solution architects, platform engineers, security teams, and business stakeholders to deliver API products aligned to bank integration patterns, including synchronous REST services and event-driven integrations.

Direct line reporting:

Head of Architecture and Core Banking – Europe.
Accountabilities And Responsibilities

API Design & Delivery

Design and implement RESTful APIs and integration services connecting cloud services to on‑prem banking systems.
Create reusable API patterns for common banking capabilities (customer, accounts, payments, transactions, entitlements).
Define and maintain API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), versioning strategies, and backward compatibility.
Deliver APIs that meet performance, latency, availability, and resiliency expectations (e.g., timeouts, retries, circuit breakers).

Security, Compliance & Controls

Implement strong API security controls: OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, JWT validation, request signing, API gateway policies, and rate limiting.
Apply secure coding practices and align solutions with bank security standards, audit requirements, and regulatory expectations (e.g., least privilege, encryption in transit/at rest).
Collaborate with security to support threat modeling, pen test remediation, and secure configuration management.

Cloud–On‑Prem Connectivity & Integration

Build and operate integration flows using enterprise tooling (examples: API gateway, service mesh, ESB/iPaaS, message brokers).
Implement hybrid connectivity patterns such as VPN/ExpressRoute/Direct Connect equivalents, private endpoints, network segmentation, and secure routing.
Integrate with on‑prem technologies (e.g., MQ, legacy services, SOAP where required, databases, batch systems) and modern cloud services.

Observability & Operations

Implement observability: structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
Support production deployments and incident triage; conduct root cause analysis and introduce reliability improvements.
Automate CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure/Configuration as Code where applicable.

Engineering Excellence

Write clean, testable code (unit/integration/contract tests).
Participate in code reviews, technical design reviews, and architecture governance.
Document API products and integration runbooks for support and operational readiness.
Experience and Key Competencies:

Knowledge & Experience:

5+ years (adjust as needed) developing APIs/integration services in regulated enterprise environments; banking or financial services experience strongly preferred.
BA/MBA in IT or relevant experience
Proven experience building hybrid integrations: cloud to on‑prem application connectivity and secure data exchange.
Strong hands-on experience with API design, implementation, and lifecycle management.

Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in one or more of: Java (Spring Boot), .NET, Node.js, or Python for API development.
Strong experience with API gateways (e.g., Apigee, Kong, Azure API Management, AWS API Gateway, Mulesoft, etc.).
Experience with messaging/eventing platforms: Kafka, MQ, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, etc.
Experience with containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift.
Strong understanding of integration patterns: sync/async, pub/sub, idempotency, retries, backpressure, saga/compensation, and data consistency.
Strong understanding of data formats (JSON, XML, Avro) and schema evolution.

Security & Quality

Practical experience implementing OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, certificate management, secrets management (e.g., Vault, Key Vault, Secrets Manager).
Experience with SDLC controls: SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, secure CI pipelines.
Test automation: unit tests, integration tests, consumer-driven contract testing (e.g., Pact).

Personal Attributes

Highly organised, proactive, and detail‑oriented, with the ability to operate at pace.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and adapting to changing priorities.
Resilient, calm under pressure, and confident acting as an extension of the CIO.
Trusted partner with a collaborative, inclusive leadership style.
Banking domain knowledge: payments (SEPA/SWIFT), card processing, transaction monitoring, AML/KYC, customer onboarding.
Exposure to 4th generation banking platforms such as (Thought Machine or 10X)
Experience with service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) and zero trust patterns.
Familiarity with TOGAF, enterprise integration architecture, or API product management.
Experience with data privacy and retention requirements (GDPR), and operational controls.

Key Competencies:

Communications & Relationships:

Excellent communication skills required to manage third party relationships. Ability to use insights and relationships to influence and deliver. The ability to build connections and partnerships within own business area and beyond, through formal and informal channels, utilising considerable tact, diplomacy and people skills.

Agility and innovation:

Adapt quickly to changing priorities; create new and better ways for the organization to be successful.

Collaboration:

Build partnerships and promote a culture of teamwork to drive on U.S. Bank.

Drive for results:

Hold self and others accountable to consistently achieve meaningful results.

Ethics and trust:

Maintain high ethical standards; gain the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity and authenticity.

Inclusion:

Build a culture of equity and inclusion in which diverse ideas, talent and perspectives are welcomed and encouraged.

Customer centricity:

Build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions.

Commercial Judgement:

Strong knowledge of business unit with the ability to understand USBE’s business and deliver the business performance needed to achieve USBE’s purpose and goals.

Managing Programs:

Proven analytical, decision-making and problem-solving skills, with the ability to plan and implement appropriate measures to mitigate the impact of an event affecting USBE’s ability to achieve its objectives. To complete day-to-day activities in a manner which is consistent with legal, regulatory and stakeholder expectations.

C# .NET
Angular
Azure

Engineers at SimCorp are expected to shape how the work gets done, not just execute what's handed to them. If you want to own something end to end and work alongside people who take the craft seriously, this is the right environment.

Lead the design and architecture of software solutions that meet both business needs and engineering standards, and be accountable for the outcome.

Set the standard for code quality. Code reviews are how you scale your judgment across the team.

What We Value

5+ years of software engineering experience, with experience leading technically complex projects.
Solid foundation in software design, distributed systems, and engineering best practices.

On top of that, we have dedicated time you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. new_jobs.description:
Summary

Forward Deployed Engineers are the engineering core of Avanade Next. They sit inside the client from week one and turn business ambition into production reality — proving the direction in Consulting with a working prototype, leading the build in Studios, and configuring products for client environments. They work alongside business stakeholders, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand what matters commercially, then build the system that delivers it.

This is not a order-taking role. Forward Deployed Engineers help clients decide what should be built, challenge assumptions where the value is not there, and lead the work through to live deployment. They work in small expert teams directing agent networks rather than large delivery pyramids, and they carry accountability from the first brief through to production — which is unusual, and is the point.

Key Responsibilities

Work with clients, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand business priorities and translate them into practical AI-enabled solutions.
Build and deploy agentic AI systems end-to-end, embedded with the client and shipping from the first weeks of an engagement.
Help clients identify where AI can create meaningful value, challenge assumptions where necessary, and shape solutions that are commercially viable and technically feasible at enterprise scale.
In Consulting: build the working prototype that proves the strategy is real rather than theoretical.
In Studios: take use cases from prototype to production-grade agentic systems with the engineering rigour that implies.
In Products: configure and deploy pre-built agentic products into client environments.
Design on the Avanade Agentic Platform and the Microsoft AI stack, choosing the right combination of Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry and AAP for the business problem.
Apply AI-native engineering practices — agent-assisted development, automated evaluation, reusable components, observability and production operations.
Work with Trust Architects on evaluation, accuracy and guardrails as part of the build, not as a later gate.
Work with Value Architects so what is built stays connected to the measurable outcome it was funded for.
Contribute reusable components, patterns and assets to the APAC IP library and the Avanade Agentic Platform on every engagement.
Operate with high autonomy in the client's environment, including in the ambiguity of early-stage discovery.

KEY MEASURES

Client outcomes achieved through production deployments, evidenced by business value realised and client referenceability
Production-grade delivery on every engagement; no prototype handed over without a production path.
Demonstrable productivity through AI-native engineering practices and agent utilisation.
Reusable assets contributed to the library from every engagement.
Accuracy and evaluation thresholds met before release.

Qualifications

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

5+ years in software or AI engineering, with production systems to point to.
Strong practical command of Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI and agent orchestration; equivalent depth on another stack considered if the transfer is credible.
Full-stack capability — front end, APIs, data and agent orchestration — enough to ship something whole.
Experience building and evaluating agentic systems, including retrieval, tool use, and failure handling.
Comfortable being deployed into a client environment with high autonomy and direct exposure to stakeholders.
Track record of turning a prototype into production at pace, without leaving the mess for someone else.
Able to hold a business conversation as well as a technical one — comfortable in front of client stakeholders without an intermediary.

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. Our corporate activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a Fullstack .NET Developer
to join our Information Technology team. The Fullstack .NET Developer position will work on a team focused on our core clinical systems as well as internal applications. Strong attention to detail, innovation, and implementation of new technologies are highly valued.

To meet our global and innovation demands, Medpace is rapidly growing our software development footprint beyond the US. To support our growth, we are expanding our existing office in Leuven to build our first non-US development center. This is an incredible opportunity to join, contribute, and shape a new team, while also being a part of a large, fast-growing organization. Our custom software is a key component to our success. You will be joining an organization where your contribution makes a significant impact in positively impacting people's lives, as new treatments and therapeutics are developed.

Responsibilities

Collect, analyze and document user requirements;
Design, modify, develop and support software applications;
Participate in software validation process through development, review, and/or execution of test plan/cases/scripts;
Create software applications by following software development life-cycle, which includes requirements gathering, design, development, testing, release, and maintenance;
Communicate with team members regarding projects, development, tools, and procedures;
Utilize skills in development areas including object oriented programming (C#), databases (SQL) web applications (ASP.NET);
Potential opportunities to lead software development projects.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science;
At least 2 years of software development experience using technologies such as C#, Angular, Webservices, GraphQL, Git, relational databases;
Experience in Entity Framework, Azure DevOps is advantageous;
Understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) and software release management;
Prior experience modernizing systems to a cloud-based platform (Azure) is a plus;
Excellent analytical, written and oral communication skills in English.

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

Collaborative Culture

Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

Continuous Growth & Development

Office based environment with on-site mentors
Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
Company-sponsored social events

Please note benefits may vary based on country.

What To Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

new_jobs.title: Full Stack .NET Developer (Innovation Lab)
new_jobs.description:
Protime
is een succesvolle internationale aanbieder van Workforce Management
oplossingen. Met onze software en expertise helpen wij bedrijven om efficiënter om te gaan met de tijd van hun werknemers: hun Human Capital, dus. Bij Protime krijg je de kans om te groeien, nieuwe dingen te proberen, je talenten te benutten en verder te ontplooien, … Er heerst een sfeer van samenwerking: together we get the job done. Je krijgt veel autonomie en kan ownership nemen in je rol, maar je staat er nooit alleen voor.

Ben jij een pionier die graag nieuwe technologieën verkent en ideeën omzet in werkende proof of concepts? Let’s meet! 🚀

Wat zal je doen als Innovation Developer bij Protime?

Als Full Stack .NET Develope
r werk je in ons Innovation Lab
. Samen met een gedreven team verken je nieuwe technologieën en ontwikkel je praktische toepassingen die direct waarde toevoegen aan onze producten.

Je werkt in een feedback-driven
omgeving, waarin je continu leert, verbetert en bijstuurt op basis van gebruikersinzichten en teaminput. Een nieuwsgierige houding
en een innovatieve mindset
zijn hierbij onmisbaar.

Vertaal ideeën naar prototypes: Je zet concepten om in werkende POCs binnen verschillende innovatietracks. Je schakelt snel van idee naar uitvoering en past continu bij op basis van feedback en testresultaten.
Verken nieuwe technologieën: Je experimenteert met de nieuwste tools en frameworks binnen het .NET-ecosysteem (vanaf versie 8) en combineert dit met moderne front-end technologieën zoals TypeScript en React. AI en data-driven oplossingen? Helemaal jouw ding!
Samenwerken en kennis delen: Je werkt nauw samen met interne experts (architecten, developers) en externe partners zoals Microsoft en AI-specialisten. Je introduceert nieuwe technologieën, deelt inzichten en inspireert je team.
Feedback-driven ontwikkeling: Je haalt actief input op bij eindgebruikers en gebruikt deze om prototypes te verfijnen. Je presenteert je ideeën aan zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders en zorgt dat iedereen begrijpt wat er mogelijk is.
Ruimte voor experimentatie: Je krijgt de vrijheid om buiten de standaard development flow te werken, nieuwe methoden uit te proberen en snel te schakelen.

Jouw skills en mindset

Je bent geen klassieke developer, maar een pionier
met een nieuwsgierige mindset en een brede interesse in zowel nieuwe als gevestigde technologieën. Je bent gepassioneerd over technologie en gedreven om steeds te ontdekken hoe je die in de praktijk kunt toepassen. Continu bijleren is voor jou vanzelfsprekend.

Ben jij de developer die we zoeken?

Je denkt kritisch, zoekt continu naar verbeteringen en weet je ideeën helder en onderbouwd over te brengen.
Je bruist van ideeën en experimenteert graag om tot verrassende inzichten te komen.
Je neemt graag initiatief en schakelt moeiteloos tussen verschillende projecten.
Je bent communicatief sterk en kan complexe concepten duidelijk uitleggen aan zowel technische als niet-technische collega’s.
Je blijft op de hoogte van trends in web development, service-oriented architecturen en AI-tools.

Technische skills

Sterke expertise in .NET 8 (of hogere versies).
Ervaring met frontend development (TypeScript of JavaScript; React is een plus).
Interesse in of ervaring met AI-development.
Vertrouwd met TDD, BDD, clean code en simple design.
Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Brutoloon: tussen €4000 en €5000 per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring.
Voordelenpakket:
Bedrijfswagen met tankkaart/laadkaart
Netto-onkostenvergoeding
Maaltijdcheques en ecocheques
Hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering
Eindejaarspremie en jaarlijkse bonus
GSM abonnement en een voucher voor een toestel
FIP-plan (Flex Income Plan/cafetariaplan)

Werkregime: 40-urenweek met 12 ADV-dagen

Waarom voor Protime kiezen? ⌚

Protime is een groeibedrijf met een internationale mindset. Dat betekent dat jij impact kan maken, jezelf voortdurend kan blijven ontwikkelen en kan meegroeien met het bedrijf.
Werken bij Protime staat voor werken binnen een omgeving met snelle beslissingsprocedures en korte communicatielijnen. We omarmen verandering en nieuwe ideeën worden volop aangemoedigd.
We houden ervan ons werk en elkaar naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Samen presteren op ons best en voldoening halen uit ons werk: daar gaan we voor!
Bij ons werk je hybride: afwisselend vanop ons hoofdkantoor in Mechelen en van thuis. De werktijden zijn flexibel. De focus ligt op de kwaliteit van je werk.

Du koordinierst dich mit internen Teams in der Schweiz, einem Nearshore-Team in Madrid sowie externen Partner:innen.
Du stellst sicher, dass Codequalität, Standards und Best Practices eingehalten werden.
Du bist technischer Sparring-Partner für Entwickler:innen und Solution Architects.

Das macht dich aus

Du hast eine abgeschlossene Informatikausbildung, idealerweise auf Stufe FH/HF.
Du bringst mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Dynamics sowie fundierte Pro-Code-Entwicklungserfahrung auf der Microsoft Power Platform mit.
Du kennst dich sehr gut mit Power Apps, Power Automate und Dataverse aus und verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in C#.
Du hast Erfahrung in Softwaredesign, Integration und teamübergreifender Zusammenarbeit.
Du verfügst idealerweise über Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wie PL-400 oder PL-600.
Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

Das macht uns aus

Ein spannender Job. Eine sinnstiftende Arbeit. Und dann noch zahlreiche weitere Vorteile, die dir CKW bietet.

💰 Attraktive Vergütung und umfangreiche Sozialleistungen: Freue dich auf faire Bezahlung und umfassende Vorsorgepakete, die deine Zukunft absichern.

📅 Beruf und Privatleben im Einklang: Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Teilzeitmodellen und bis zu 50% Home-Office (je nach Tätigkeit) ermöglichen wir eine gesunde Balance zwischen Arbeit und Privatleben.

🚌 Attraktive Extras: Profitiere von unseren Angeboten wie vergünstigten Mobile-Abos, Unterstützung bei der Kinderbetreuung, Ferienkauf oder kostenlosen Parkplätzen. Mehr erfahren

Bei CKW setzen wir uns für eine Kultur der Nichtdiskriminierung, Toleranz und Inklusion ein. Als Arbeitgeberin, der Chancengleichheit wichtig ist, begrüssen wir Bewerbungen unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlechtsidentität und -ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung sowie sozialem, kulturellem und religiösem Hintergrund. Design, development and further development of backend services in C#/.NET for a fleet management system of mobile robots
Development of full-stack features with Vue.js, TypeScript and modern web technologies
Design and implementation of interfaces between robots, control systems and higher-level IT systems
Analysis of technical requirements and development of scalable and robust software architectures

Ensuring software quality through testing, code reviews and continuous integration
Close cooperation with product owners, robotics specialists and other software developers
Documentation of software architecture and development processes

Successfully completed IT training (HTL, FH/UNI) with a focus on software development, or comparable training related to software development
Several years of experience in C# programming as well as knowledge of HTML5, Vue.js and JavaScript

Analytical mindset and very good conceptual skills

Working with high-quality IT equipment and the latest technologies

Sustainability and security of a foundation-owned company: the majority of profits remain within the company and are reinvested, another part is going to charitable projects

new_jobs.description:
About The Job

The Senior Developer’s mission is to contribute to the functional and application related consistency of the IT solution and ensure the service continuity and continuous development. The Developer must perform activities within the framework of projects and/or application maintenance and development, seeking its continuous development and assuring its compliance with Quality and Security guidelines and best practices
We are looking for a Senior .NET Developer with expertise in analysing legacy implementations and implementing new systems following industry best practices. In addition to technical skills, soft skills like proactivity, outstanding communication abilities, and effective teamwork, are essential prerequisites. Candidates will engage with diverse locations and cultures, making cultural adaptability a valuable asset
As members of our IT department, Developers play a pivotal role in ensuring uninterrupted service delivery and elevating the overall quality of our IT operations

Your Main Activities Are

Software solution analysis, design, and implementation compliant with IT Department’s guidelines
Use of development best practices
Apply unit testing and follow the recommendations for high quality code
A team oriented profile working on a SCRUM environment

Profile
and Skills to Success

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology and Computer Science or related
At least 10 years of experience in Information Rechnology or similar
Advanced level of English, both written and oral
Knowledge in C# .NET / SQL / Angular / Design Pattern / Dependency Injection / Test-Driven Development GIT/SVN
Creative and logical thinking to analyse a change request or problem or issue and define potential solutions or improvements, ways to do it, and being able to transpose logical thinking into a schematic diagram and documents for both presentation, discussion, and documentation
Ability to work in fast paced global environment
Attention to detail / rigour
Ability to collaborate / teamwork
Analytical ability

Why joining BNP Paribas?

BNP Paribas, The European Leader In Banking And Financial Services In Europe, Operates In 64 Countries And Has Nearly 180,000 Employees. The Group Is Structured Around Three Operating Divisions. Its Business Lines Cooperate Closely, As Part Of Our Integrated Model, To Meet The Needs Of All Our Clients In a Coordinated Manner

Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities;
Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses;
Investment & Protection Services (IPS), combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate.

Our presence in Portugal

In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centers providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates.

Diversity and Inclusion Commitment

BNP Paribas´ Ambition Is To Cultivate An Open And Responsive Environment For All That Encourages Collaboration And Interaction. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As Part Of Our Local Corporate And Social Responsibility - Diversity & Inclusion Strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal Is Committed To

Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees;
Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard.

To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society.

Remote Working Conditions

At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. .

Develop a configurable Real Estate Finance & Payment Plan Engine

Strong experience with ASP.NET Core / C# or Node.js

7+ years of software development experience

Experience owning projects from architecture and development through testing, UAT, production deployment, and handover
